Sofia / Marissa — quick internal note before I reply to Sarah.

Attachment: Loadtest_Specs.xlsx (XLSX)

Key checks I want covered:
- Load test origin: run primary from us-west (us-west-2) and a short verification from eu-west-1; keep EU run to 15 minutes for routing validation.
- Traffic profile: 200 concurrent users simulated as 10 RPS/user peak; burst 30% for 3 minutes to validate autoscaling and fallback logic.
- Model variants & quantization: start on the lighter quantized variant (Q4) for the load test, failover to full-precision for spot checks if we see accuracy drift.
- Observability hooks: ensure token-level latency traces and per-route cost counters are enabled; capture one end-to-end request ID set.

Checklist for the session (for the calendar invite):
- [ ] 15-min buffer before lab for credential exchange
- [ ] Shared Drive with slides and prompt CSV attached
- [ ] Post-test notes doc and action items template
- [ ] Recording enabled / consent from Atlas

I’ll include these as bullets in my reply. Also, flagging: if we see sustained >80% GPU utilization we throttle and fall back to a lower-concurrency mode (documented in the Loadtest_Specs).

Ben
